name: QuickBooks
description: Finance and Fintech: Intuit QuickBooks Online small-business accounting platform with REST APIs for invoices, customers, payments, bills and financial reports.
access_notes: Creating an Intuit developer account and app is self-serve and immediately yields Development keys plus a sandbox QuickBooks Online company. Production credentials are only revealed after completing and passing Intuit's App Assessment Questionnaire (security/use-case compliance review), required even for private/unlisted apps.
mcp_notes: Intuit publishes an official open-source local (stdio) MCP server, intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server, covering ~143 tools / 29 entities / 11 reports; Composio has a managed QUICKBOOKS toolkit (114 tools, OAUTH2).

evidence.note: OAuth 2.0 is the documented auth protocol; separate Development (sandbox) and Production keys under Keys & OAuth.
'The Show Credentials switch appears only after the App Assessment Questionnaire is approved' — production keys are gated behind Intuit's assessment.
Self-serve developer account creation with automatic sandbox company and immediate development credentials; REST v3 endpoints (sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3).
Official Intuit MCP server repo: local stdio server exposing full CRUD for 29 entity types and 11 reports via OAuth 2.0.
Composio managed QuickBooks toolkit: OAUTH2, 114 tools, slug QUICKBOOKS.
Official webhooks docs: CloudEvents-format POST notifications for entities such as Customer, Invoice, CreditMemo with create/update/delete/merge operations.
